blocks.text: Stephen Corporate Services (SCS) Ltd ("SCS", "we", "us" or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting personal data collected in the course of its business activities.
This Privacy Notice explains what personal data we collect, why we use it, when we share it, how long we retain it, and how you can exercise your data protection rights.
It applies to our clients, prospective clients, business partners, website visitors, job applicants, employees, and individuals whose personal data we process while providing services to our clients.

We handle personal data in accordance with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA), the applicable Nigeria Data Protection Act General Application and Implementation Directive 2025 (GAID), and other relevant legal requirements.

SCS provides corporate and business support services, including contract and commercial documentation, human resource management, customer support, sales operations, regulatory compliance support, corporate registrations, and intellectual property filing coordination.
The personal data we collect depends on your relationship with SCS and the services involved.
We may collect your name, business or job title, organisation, telephone number, email address, business address, and other contact details necessary for communication and service delivery.

Where required for our services, we may process company registration documents, directors' and shareholders' details, tax identification information, licence records, contractual documents, and other corporate or regulatory records.

For recruitment, human resource management, and related services, we may process CVs, employment history, qualifications, identification documents, payroll information, emergency contacts, and relevant background-check information where lawfully required.

We may maintain enquiries, correspondence, contracts, invoices, payment records, service requests, customer support records, business development communications, and other information necessary to manage our relationships and deliver our services.

When you visit our website or use our online services, we may collect technical information such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and cookie preferences, depending on the technologies deployed.
We may receive personal data from clients, authorised representatives, business partners, service providers, and lawfully accessible public or commercial sources.
Where we process personal data on behalf of a client, the information may relate to that client's customers, employees, applicants, or other individuals.
We do not intentionally collect sensitive personal data unless it is necessary for a legitimate service or other lawful purpose and the applicable legal requirements are satisfied.

sections.heading: 4. Why We Use Your Personal Data

blocks.text: We process personal data for the following purposes:

items: **Service delivery:** To provide corporate support, contract administration, recruitment, customer care, sales operations, compliance support, and related services.
**Client and business relationship management:** To respond to enquiries, prepare proposals, communicate with clients, manage engagements, and maintain business records.
**Corporate and regulatory compliance:** To complete authorised registrations, filings, licence applications, and other regulatory processes.
**Financial administration:** To issue invoices, process payments, maintain accounting records, and meet applicable tax obligations.
**Recruitment and workforce management:** To assess applications, manage recruitment activities, administer employment arrangements, and support workforce operations.
**Website administration and security:** To maintain our online services, investigate technical problems, prevent misuse, and protect our systems.
**Business development and marketing:** To communicate relevant services, manage prospective client relationships, and conduct lawful business outreach.
**Legal claims and dispute resolution:** To establish, exercise, or defend legal rights and respond to lawful requests from competent authorities.

blocks.text: We use personal data only for purposes that are lawful and consistent with the circumstances in which the information was obtained.
Depending on the purpose and circumstances, we rely on one or more lawful bases recognised under applicable data protection law.
These may include:

items: **Contractual necessity:** Where processing is necessary to enter into or perform a contract with you.
**Legal obligation:** Where processing is required to comply with applicable law.
**Legitimate interests:** Where processing is necessary for a legitimate business purpose and the applicable legal requirements, including the protection of your rights, are satisfied.
**Consent:** Where you have freely given consent for a specified purpose and consent is the appropriate lawful basis.

blocks.text: Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it at any time. Withdrawal does not invalidate processing lawfully undertaken before withdrawal.
Where we rely on legitimate interests, we consider the purpose of the processing, its potential impact on individuals, and the safeguards necessary to protect their rights.
We do not sell personal data. We disclose it only where necessary for our business activities, the delivery of services, or compliance with applicable law.
Depending on the circumstances, recipients may include:

items: **Clients and authorised representatives:** Where information is required to provide services or complete an authorised engagement.
**Professional advisers and specialists:** Including solicitors, intellectual property agents, and other professionals engaged for relevant work.
**Government agencies and regulators:** Where necessary for authorised filings, regulatory processes, or compliance with legal obligations.
**Technology and service providers:** Including hosting providers, software providers, IT support providers, and other vendors supporting our operations.
**Other authorised recipients:** Where disclosure is required by law, a court order, or another applicable legal obligation.

blocks.text: We take appropriate steps to protect personal data shared with service providers and other recipients. Where a third party processes personal data on our behalf, we establish appropriate contractual and security arrangements.
We do not disclose personal data to third parties for their independent marketing purposes without an appropriate lawful basis.

sections.heading: 7. Processing Personal Data on Behalf of Clients

blocks.text: SCS sometimes processes personal data while providing managed services to clients, including customer support, recruitment, human resource administration, and sales operations.

In these circumstances, the client will generally determine the purposes and essential means of processing, while SCS processes the information in accordance with the applicable service arrangements and documented instructions.

Where SCS acts as a data processor, the client remains responsible for decisions assigned to it as the data controller, subject to applicable law. SCS is responsible for its own obligations as a processor.

If you wish to exercise a right concerning personal data that SCS processes solely on behalf of a client, you may contact us. Where appropriate, we will direct your request to the responsible client and provide assistance as required by law.

Where personal data is transferred outside Nigeria or made accessible to recipients in another country, we take steps to ensure that the transfer complies with the applicable requirements of the NDPA and GAID.
Depending on the circumstances, this may involve assessing the recipient, the destination, applicable safeguards, and the legal basis for the transfer.
You may contact us for further information about relevant international transfers involving your personal data.

sections.heading: 9. How Long We Retain Personal Data

blocks.text: We retain personal data only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, meet applicable legal obligations, resolve disputes, and protect legitimate business interests.
The retention period depends on the nature of the information and the relevant service or legal requirement.

When personal data is no longer required, we take appropriate steps to securely delete it, destroy it, or irreversibly anonymise it, subject to applicable retention obligations and legitimate legal holds.
We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures designed to protect personal data against unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, loss, and misuse.
These measures are intended to reflect the nature of the information processed, the purposes of processing, and the risks associated with our operations.

Access to personal data is restricted to authorised persons who require it for legitimate business purposes. We also take appropriate steps to ensure that personnel and service providers handle personal data responsibly.

No method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Nevertheless, we take reasonable steps to maintain the confidentiality, integrity, and security of the personal data entrusted to us.
Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to support essential functions, maintain security, remember preferences, and understand website performance.
Where consent is required, non-essential cookies and similar tracking technologies will be used only after the required consent has been obtained.
You may manage your preferences through the cookie settings available on our website, where implemented.
Further information about the categories of cookies used, their purposes, and how to manage them is provided in our separate Cookie Policy.
Subject to applicable law and the circumstances of the processing, you may have the right to:

items: Request access to personal data we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
Request erasure of personal data where the applicable conditions are satisfied.
Request restriction of certain processing activities.
Object to processing where the law grants that right.
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
Request data portability where the relevant conditions apply.
Seek information about relevant processing activities and applicable safeguards.
Lodge a complaint with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission.

blocks.text: You may exercise your rights by contacting us using the details in Section 14.
We may request reasonable information to verify your identity and clarify the scope of your request. We will assess and respond to requests in accordance with applicable legal requirements.
Certain rights may be subject to lawful exceptions, including circumstances in which personal data must be retained to comply with legal obligations or establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.
Our website or communications may contain links to third-party websites, platforms, or government portals.

Those services operate under their own privacy practices and policies. SCS is not responsible for the privacy practices of independent third parties, and we encourage you to review their privacy information before submitting personal data to them.
For questions about this Privacy Notice, requests concerning your personal data, or complaints about our handling of personal data, contact us through the following channels:
You may also lodge a complaint with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission through its official website:
[https://ndpc.gov.ng/](https://ndpc.gov.ng/)
We may update this Privacy Notice when our business activities, data processing practices, or applicable legal requirements change.

The latest version will be published on our website with its effective date. Where a change materially affects how we process personal data, we will provide additional information or notification where required by law.

sections.heading: This website: tools and service providers

blocks.text: This section describes what stephencorporateservices-scs.com itself does with personal data. It applies the notice above to this website.

items: **Enquiry, training and career forms** are processed by **Netlify, Inc.** (website hosting and form handling) and delivered to our team by email through **Google Workspace (Google LLC)**. We use what you submit only to respond to your request or application. Unsuccessful job applications are deleted within six (6) months.
**Our free tools** (business assessment, compliance checklist, structure chooser, Find My Service) run in your browser. Nothing is sent to us unless you choose to submit your result or details.

**Analytics:** **Plausible Analytics (Plausible Insights OÜ)** counts visits only if you accept analytics in the cookie banner. It sets no cookies and does not build personal profiles. If you reject analytics, it does not load.

**Booking:** the "Book a Discovery Call" buttons open **Cal.com** in a new tab. Our website only links to it; the details you enter there are processed under Cal.com's own terms and privacy policy and shared with us so we can hold the call.
**Website editing:** our own staff edit website content through **GitHub, Inc.** and **Netlify**. Visitors are never asked to sign in.
These providers may process data outside Nigeria. Where they do, Section 8 (International Transfers) applies.
